description: Role definitions and access scopes for mxo-track

admin.label: Administrator
admin.description: Full platform access. Manages customers, vehicles, drivers, routes, imports, reports, billing.

operator.label: Operator
operator.description: Operations access. Route planning, fleet monitoring, driver management.

customer.label: Customer
customer.description: B2B tenant. Sees only own data filtered by customer_id.

driver.label: Driver
driver.description: Delivery driver. Sees only assigned routes and stops.

public.label: Public
public.description: Unauthenticated. Can only track a single shipment by TRK token.
